I was born an American, and all my life I have heard about our freedom of speech, as if we, and we alone, invented the concept. At one time there was a modicum of truth to the idea, but that is changing rapidly.

What I remember as a young adult in the 80's is that people did have a right to say what they believed, as long as they were willing to take the consequences. Freedom of speech guaranteed the right to say what you like, but not freedom from reprisals. That was as it should be.

Since then, I have seen our freedom erode under Republicans and Democrats alike. First it was the PC movement, one that ridiculed those who said the wrong thing or used the wrong word. Then it was SJWism and the mind control they want to foist upon the world. Most recently, though, the most disturbing trend has been that it is the US government itself that is taking away our right to freedom. It started with Bush after 9/11 (ostensibly a temporary situation), but fifteen years later it is accelerating under Obama. The US is down three notches in the Press Freedom ranking from last year, with the US government pressure on NY Times reporter James Risen being one of the undeniable examples of this trend.
Expect more direct attacks on free speech in America as the NSA and other federal policing agencies seek to expand their power.
